name: Penedès
terms: Denominación de Origen Calificada, a step above DO for regions with a record of consistent quality. Only Rioja and Priorat hold it.
Denominación de Origen, Spain's main quality tier.
Spain's regional wine tier, below DO.
A single-estate wine of high quality. A pago is a vineyard estate.
Young wine, sold with little or no aging. Some see a few months in oak.

notes: Penedès makes full bodied reds from Tempranillo and Garnacha, and its cooler climate suits single-variety Tempranillo.
Xarel·lo, long a blending grape here, is now also made on its own.

blurb.text: A Catalan DO in the Penedès & Cava grouping, framed by the coastal Garraf hills and the higher inland mountains. Since the 2025 harvest, all of its production has been certified organic. Allowed grapes include Xarello, Macabeo and Parellada, plus many red and international varieties.
